column1: # Astrion Assistant — how people actually ask for things.
# phrase<TAB>the intent it should route to
# Generated by a language model asked to paraphrase each request the way a real
# person types it: casual, terse, polite, indirect. That is the ONE job a big
# model is genuinely good at here, and it is also the job that needs checking —
# so nothing in this file is trusted. tools/intent_probe.c runs every line
# through the real am_classify/am_action_of and reports which ones Astrion
# drops or misroutes. Those are the gaps.
# Lines are deliberately NOT all achievable. A corpus that only contains
# phrasings the matcher already handles measures nothing.
